text:
ana: quick one — proposal for a new geo dashboard that combines runtime + infra signals. core goals: surface per-region latency (p50/p95/p99), cross-region failover impact, traffic split percentages, and region capacity slack. Need clarity on data owners and exact metrics we can rely on.

sam: +1. low-cardinality is important here. runtime can emit region and routing_policy as labels — that should cover most panels. who owns lb/failover counts? @rita? :eyes:

lee: we can add labels from the runtime side: region, az, model_variant, routing_policy. kv-cache hit/miss metrics exist but don't have routing_policy yet — can add. FYI cardinality cost ~+0.5% on metric ingestion for labeled histograms. plan: add routing_policy label by EOD Fri.

rita: SRE here — we own LB failover counters (haproxy/prometheus job). we also want tracing exemplars to correlate failovers with tail latency. Suggest a panel that overlays failover spikes + p99 latency. Also add a failover_count metric with from_region -> to_region labels.

infra-bot: existing metrics (auto-list): runtime_request_latency_seconds_bucket{region,route}, runtime_kv_cache_hit_total{region}, lb_failovers_total{from_region,to_region}, routing_traffic_fraction{region,route}. full index: /ops/metrics.

mike: Product/Console POV — UX question: heatmap (regions x time) or per-region timelines with drilldowns? Product prefers a heatmap overview + per-region detail panels.

ana: ana typo correction? (lol) — agreed on heatmap + timeline. We should capture p95 colorscale on heatmap and allow selecting windows to inspect failover traces. Need example queries for the dashboard panels. @sam can you draft PromQLs?

sam: will do. sketch PromQLs here:
```
# p95 latency per region (histogram_quantile)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))

# failover rate (per minute, aggregated by from_region->to_region)
rate(lb_failovers_total[5m])

# traffic split percentage per region (percent of requests)
100 * sum(rate(runtime_requests_total[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(runtime_requests_total[5m]))
```

rita: Add synthetic canary probes too — simple cross-region p99 probe every 5m to surface routing-policy regressions. We'll own probe orchestration.

lee: on retention/rollups: propose keep raw histograms for 15d, and roll up p50/p95/p99 timeseries for 90d. any objections?

mike: :thumbsup: sounds reasonable. Also add regional p99 SLO burn alerts to the list — product wants proactive notifications before failover thresholds.

sam: I'll own drafting the Grafana dashboard JSON + PR once labels are emitted. I'll include heatmap panel + per-region timeline + failover overlay + traffic-split pie.

rita: I'll draft alert recipes for regional p99 SLOs and failover surge. Will add exemplar linking to traces.

ana: next steps summary — lee adds routing_policy label on runtime histograms, infra exposes lb_failovers_total (with from/to labels), sam drafts dashboard PR, rita adds alerts, mike mockups console UX. sync Tue 10am to review first draft. thanks all! :rocket:

sam: I'll put a stub PR link in this thread when it's ready.

lee: will tag here once label rollout is live.

rita: filing an incident-prep checklist for cross-region failovers into /sre/runbooks and will link here.

infra-bot: scheduled: metric-exporter rollout to production at 2026-04-13T22:00Z (no expected downtime).

mike: LGTM, see you Tue.
